select count(*) from ( select p.product_id from product p left join stock s on p.product_id = s.product_id left join product_image i on p.image_id = i.image_id left join ( select category_id, ltrim(sys_connect_by_path(category_name,'>'),'>') as category_path from category start with parent_id is null connect by prior category_id = parent_id ) c on p.category_id = c.category_id
(p.product_name LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR c.category_path LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%')
AND p.status = #{status}
group by p.product_id, p.product_name, p.price, p.unit, i.file_path, i.save_name, c.category_path, p.status )

select s.stock_id as stockId, l.lot_in_id as lotInId, p.product_name as productName, s.quantity as quantity, l.expiration_date as expirationDate from stock s join product p on p.product_id=s.product_id join lot_in l on l.lot_in_id = s.lot_in_id where p.product_id = #{productId} and expiration_date >= sysdate order by expiration_date asc
select * from ( select s.*, rownum from stock s where product_id=#{value} and quantity <> 0 ) where rownum=1
